task: Predict TP53 mutation status in lung adenocarcinoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. Key H&E clues include tumor grade, nuclear pleomorphism, mitotic activity, solid growth, and necrosis, which are often more pronounced in TP53-mutant tumors.

classes.0: TP53 wildtype lung adenocarcinoma with relatively lower-grade cytology, less pleomorphism, and more orderly glandular differentiation.
classes.1: TP53 mutant lung adenocarcinoma with high-grade nuclei, increased mitoses, solid growth, and tumor necrosis.
